message: As a grandparent, I often find myself playing referee between the kids and their grand ideas when stormy weather hits. It’s all fun and games until someone suggests a backyard swim in the rain! I came across a handy resource from the National Weather Service about staying safe during storms. It’s a great reminder that while the kids might see adventure, we adults see the importance of keeping everyone safe and sound at home. So, let’s tackle those stormy days with a little planning and a lot of common sense. 🌧️
